scripts.build: bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui-tokens build && bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui build && bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui-native build
scripts.check: bun run build && bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui typecheck && bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui-native typecheck && bun --filter ink-ui-preview typecheck && bun --filter ink-ui-docs typecheck && bun test
scripts.preview: bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui-tokens build && bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui build && bun --filter ink-ui-preview start
scripts.docs: bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui-tokens build && bun --filter @adrian-danciu/ink-ui build && bun --filter ink-ui-docs start
scripts.release: bun run check && bun x --bun changeset publish
